Why Choose AMCP?

🤖

Multi-Agent Architecture

Build sophisticated distributed systems with intelligent agents that communicate seamlessly across networks.

⚡

Event-Driven Communication

Real-time message passing with CloudEvents specification support for reliable, scalable agent interactions.

🧠

LLM Integration

Native support for Large Language Models including TinyLlama for intelligent agent behavior and decision making.

🌐

Enterprise Scalable

Production-ready framework with clustering, monitoring, and security features for enterprise deployments.

🔒

Secure by Design

End-to-end encryption, authentication, and authorization built into the core communication protocol.

📊

Observable & Monitored

Comprehensive metrics, logging, and health checks with Prometheus integration for operational excellence.

Why Choose AMCP?

🤖

Multi-Agent Coordination

Seamlessly coordinate multiple intelligent agents with built-in discovery, routing, and lifecycle management.

⚡

Event-Driven Architecture

CloudEvents v1.0 compliant messaging with hierarchical topic routing and delivery guarantees.

🧠

LLM Integration

Native support for Large Language Models with TinyLlama, OpenAI, and custom AI providers.

🌐

Enterprise Scalable

Production-ready with monitoring, metrics, security, and support for distributed deployments.

🔧

Developer Friendly

Rich CLI, comprehensive documentation, examples, and testing frameworks for rapid development.

🚀

High Performance

Optimized for low latency and high throughput with async processing and efficient resource usage.

Quick Start

1

Download AMCP

Get the latest release or clone from GitHub

git clone https://github.com/agentmeshcommunicationprotocol/amcpcore.github.io.git
2

Build & Run

Compile and start the interactive CLI

mvn clean package
java -jar cli/target/amcp-cli-1.5.0.jar
3

Activate Agents

Start using multi-agent capabilities

amcp> activate weather
amcp> weather London
amcp> activate orchestrator
